title: Evaluation on the generator for parameterwise scalar continuous procyclic cochains
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with its extended norm topology, a finite intermediate field $E$, and $F=E$ or $F=\Omega$. Use all continuous maps, as in [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring], and the profinite parameter universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Put $H=\mathbf Z_\ell$ with its inverse-limit topology and additive notation. For every profinite set $S$ define a nonnegative complex of abstract $C(S,F)$-modules by
$$U_F^q(S)=C(S\times H^q,F),\qquad
(df)(s;t_1,\ldots,t_{q+1})=f(s;t_2,\ldots,t_{q+1})+\sum_{i=1}^q(-1)^if(s;t_1,\ldots,t_i+t_{i+1},\ldots,t_{q+1})+(-1)^{q+1}f(s;t_1,\ldots,t_q).$$
Here $H^0$ is a point, $d^0=0$, and scalar multiplication is through $S$. Let $K_F(S)$ have $C(S,F)$ in degrees $0,1$, zero elsewhere, and zero differential. The maps
$$\epsilon_S^0=1_{C(S,F)},\qquad \epsilon_S^1(f)(s)=f(s;1),\qquad \epsilon_S^q=0\quad(q\geq2)$$
are natural under every continuous $S'\to S$, including the empty set, and commute with the coefficient inclusion $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$. Thus they define a cochain map $\epsilon:U_F^\bullet\to K_F$ of internal $A_F$-modules, where $A_F(S)=C(S,F)$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. This map is a quasi-isomorphism of sheaf complexes: its map on the kernel/image cohomology sheaves is an isomorphism, without taking closures [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. In particular, local existence of primitives is meant in the finite jointly surjective profinite topology; no assertion of a global primitive over every parameter set is imposed. The assertion concerns these explicit underived function-sheaf complexes, not internal condensed right derived invariant functors. The noncomplete norm field $\Omega$ and all its continuous functions are retained.
